# Yuri Kan

> > A comprehensive QA and test automation resource featuring expert insights on modern testing frameworks, AI-powered testing, and quality leadership from a Senior QA Lead with Google/Waze experience.

Yuri Kan's site provides in-depth educational content, practical guides, and industry analysis on QA automation, testing tools, and AI applications in software testing. The site includes a comprehensive 325-lesson QA course and regularly updated tool release analysis.

## Key Topics

- Test Automation
- Playwright
- Cypress
- Selenium
- Jest
- JUnit
- AI Testing
- API Testing
- QA Leadership
- WCAG Accessibility
- GitHub Copilot
- Amazon CodeWhisperer
- CI/CD
- Machine Learning
- Quality Assurance

## Core Resources

- [Yuri Kan - Senior QA Lead and Test Automation Expert](https://yrkan.com): Homepage for Yuri Kan's QA expertise, test automation, and AI testing insights
- [QA Engineering Course: Zero to Senior](https://yrkan.com/course): 325-lesson QA course covering Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, API testing, and leadership
- [About Yuri Kan](https://yrkan.com/about): Bio of Senior QA Lead from Google (Waze) specializing in test automation and AI testing

## AI & Advanced Testing Techniques

- [AI Copilot for Test Automation: GitHub Copilot and Amazon CodeWhisperer](https://yrkan.com/blog/ai-copilot-testing): GitHub Copilot vs CodeWhisperer for Selenium and Playwright test automation
- [AI Code Smell Detection: Finding Problems in Test Automation with ML](https://yrkan.com/blog/ai-code-smell-detection): CodeBERT and ML-based detection of test automation anti-patterns and flaky tests
- [AI for Performance Anomaly Detection in Testing](https://yrkan.com/blog/ai-performance-anomaly): LSTM and Isolation Forest algorithms for performance anomaly detection in QA testing
- [AI Log Analysis: Intelligent Error Detection and Root Cause Analysis](https://yrkan.com/blog/ai-log-analysis): AI-powered log analysis for error detection and root cause analysis in QA automation
- [A/B Testing for Machine Learning Models: ML Experimentation](https://yrkan.com/blog/ab-testing-ml-models): A/B testing strategies for ML models with statistical significance and rollout tactics

- [Jest v30.3.0 Update: defineConfig, Timer Tick Mode & Key Fixes](https://yrkan.com/tools-updates/jest-v30-3-whats-new): Jest v30.3.0 release with defineConfig, fake timers, and ESM support improvements
- [JUnit 6.0.3 Release: Stability Updates for Test Automation](https://yrkan.com/tools-updates/junit5-r6-0-whats-new): JUnit 6.0.3 patch release with stability improvements for QA test automation
- [Flyway 12.1.1 Update: Key Fixes & QA Impact](https://yrkan.com/tools-updates/flyway-flyway-12-1-whats-new): Flyway 12.1.1 database migration updates and impact on QA testing workflows
